chunks: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying:
'Musa ibn Imran passed by among seventy prophets upon the glens of al-Rawha, upon them were the Qatwaniyya cloaks, saying: "Here I am, Your servant, son of Your servant."'

key_terms.الْعَبَاءُ الْقَطَوَانِيَّةُ: The Qatwaniyya cloaks — simple woolen garments from the Qatwan region, symbolizing the humility of ihram
key_terms.فِجَاجِ الرَّوْحَاءِ: The glens/valleys of al-Rawha — a known geographic area on the road between Medina and Mecca, approximately 36 miles from Medina
key_terms.لَبَّيْكَ: Labbayk — the Talbiyya, the ritual call of the pilgrim: 'Here I am (O God), here I am'

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Musa (Moses) perform Hajj according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Abu Basir narrates from Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him) that the Prophet Musa (Moses) son of Imran, accompanied by seventy prophets, traversed the valleys of al-Rawha on their way to perform the Hajj pilgrimage. They wore simple woolen cloaks from Qatwan and recited the Talbiyya — the sacred pilgrimage invocation — declaring their servitude to God. This narration highlights that Hajj was a sacred obligation observed by all prophets across history, uniting them in a common act of worship.
word_analysis: Here I am (at Your service), Labbayk

en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Al Mukhtar, from Abu Baseer who said, 
‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying:
‘Musaas Bin Imranas passed by among seventy Prophetsas upon the glens of Al-Rawha. Upon them were the Qatwany cloaks, saying: ‘Here I am, Yourazwj servant son of Yourazwj servant! (Talbiyya )’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar from abu Basir who has said the following: “I once heard abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ‘

Moses, son of ‘Imran, passed by the wide road in al- Rawha’ (a place between al-Madinah and Makkah), along with seventy prophets dressed with gowns made in al-Qatwan, near al-Kufa, Iraq, saying, “Here I am to obey Your command O Lord, Your servant, son of Your servant.’””
